Test Ki Tayyari

Admission Test Syllabus

Admission test sirf 3 books se hoga — English, Science aur Mathematics. Har book ke pehle 2 chapters syllabus mein shamil hain — tafseel neeche har book ke card mein di gayi hai.

📘

English

Book ke pehle 2 chapters se test hoga:

  • Chapter 1 Shamil Hai
  • Chapter 2 Shamil Hai
🔬

Science

Book ke pehle 2 chapters se test hoga:

  • Chapter 1 Shamil Hai
  • Chapter 2 Shamil Hai
➗

Mathematics

Book ke pehle 2 chapters se test hoga:

  • Chapter 1 Shamil Hai
  • Chapter 2 Shamil Hai

Note: Sirf upar diye gaye chapters hi test mein aayenge — mazeed tafseel ya kisi shak ki surat mein school office se rabta karein.

Parents Ke Liye

Pre-9th kyun zaroori hai?

Zyada tar talibat 9th mein aakar ek dam mushkil course aur board pattern ki wajah se peeche reh jati hain. Pre-9th wohi khala pehle se pur karta hai.

🏆

Board Mein Behtar Position

Course pehle cover hone se 9th–10th mein sirf revision aur practice reh jati hai — numbers behtar aate hain.

🧪

Science Ki Mazboot Bunyad

Physics, Chemistry aur Biology ke mushkil concepts Pre-9th mein aahista aur samajh kar parhaye jate hain.

📝

Paper Pattern Ki Practice

Board jaisa paper, waqt ki pabandi aur presentation — test session se exam ka dar khatam hota hai.

👩‍🏫

Sirf Larkiyon Ka Mahol

Mehfooz, ba-parda aur pur-sukoon mahol jahan har taliba be-jhijhak sawal pooch sakti hai.

📖

Urdu Subjects Par Khaas Tawajjo

Urdu, Islamiyat aur Pakistan Studies — teeno subjects board format mein mukammal tayyari ke saath.

💬

Parents Ko Regular Report

Tests aur progress ki maloomat parents ko milti rehti hai, taake ghar se bhi nazar rakhi ja sake.

Course Detail

9th Class ke tamam subjects

Pre-9th mein wohi sab kuch hoga jo board ke paper mein hota hai — koi subject nahi chhodega.

🔬 Science Group

Physics • Chemistry • Biology / Computer Science • Mathematics — numericals, definitions, diagrams aur practical concepts ke saath.

📚 Compulsory Subjects

English • Urdu • Islamiyat • Pakistan Studies • Tarjuma-tul-Quran — grammar, essay, translation aur board ke sawalat ki practice ke saath.

Admission Guide

Dakhla kaise lein?

4 aasan steps — koi online jhanjhat nahi, seedha school office se dakhla confirm karein.

01

School Visit Karein

Unique Girls Higher Secondary School, Shakargarh ke office tashreef layein.

02

Form Lein Aur Bharein

Admission form office se milega — taliba ki maloomat durust likhein.

03

Documents Jama Karein

Neeche di gayi list ke mutabiq documents form ke saath lagayein.

04

Test Dein Aur Classes Join Karein

Admission test de kar dakhla confirm karein aur phir classes join karein.

🗂 Dakhle Ke Liye Zaroori Documents

  • 1 Taliba ka B-Form / Birth Certificate ki copy
  • 2 Walid ke CNIC ki copy
  • 3 Pichli class (8th) ka result card / school leaving certificate
  • 4 Taliba ki 2–4 passport size tasaveer
  • 5 Mukammal bhara hua admission form

Note: Final list office se confirm kar lein — koi document kam ho to office rehnumai karega.

Aam Sawalat

Sawal Jawab

Pre-9th kya hoti hai?

Pre-9th ek tayyari wali class hai jisme 9th ka course pehle se shuru kar diya jata hai. Is se taliba ko board class mein aane se pehle hi course, test aur paper pattern ki practice ho jati hai.

Kya 8th mein parhne wali taliba bhi dakhla le sakti hai?

Jee haan — jo talibat 8th mein hain ya 8th pass kar chuki hain, wohi Pre-9th 2026 ke liye ahel hain. Final eligibility office se confirm kar lein.

Test ka exact waqt kahan se milega?

Admission test ka exact waqt school office tay karta hai — test wale din se pehle office se waqt confirm kar lein.

Fee aur aakhri tareekh kya hai?

Fee, discount aur aakhri tareekh har saal school office tay karta hai. Sahi maloomat ke liye school office, Shakargarh se rabta karein.

Kya test session bhi hoga?

Jee — school ke Papers / Test Session system ke mutabiq regular tests honge, jisme Urdu, Islamiyat aur Pakistan Studies ke papers mukammal Urdu aur board format mein honge.

🎓

Apni beti ko ek saal aage kar dein

Pre-9th 2026 ke liye dakhle jari hain — seats limited hain. Aaj hi school office visit karein ya call kar ke apni seat confirm karein.
